source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949, p. 5 ("County and rural council elections: results"); Belfast News-Letter, 19 May 1949, p. 4 ("Rural councils: four new members in Castlereagh"); Belfast Telegraph, 6 June 1949, p. 2 ("Notice of Result of Elections: Lisburn Rural District, election of councillors, 1949")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Lisburn rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. All 15 divisions are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (John M. Shirley, returning officer, Rural Council Offices, Dublin Road, Lisburn, dated 3 June 1949; Belfast Telegraph, 6 June 1949, p. 2): only Lambeg was polled; twelve members were sole candidates, and in Ballinderry and Montiaghs, with no nomination, the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed; places of abode are not reproduced. Mrs. K. Erith defeated Desmond J. M'Kinstry. Majority 157.
